date_alignment.stock_code: normalize to six digits; codes beginning 5 or 6 map to .SH, all others to .SZ
date_alignment.sina_timestamp: parse UTC then convert to Asia/Shanghai; invalid timestamps are rejected
date_alignment.cninfo_timestamp: use published_at when valid and fall back to announcement_date; many historical records have date-level rather than intraday precision
date_alignment.event_center_date: first exchange trading date greater than or equal to publication calendar date
date_alignment.entry_date: first exchange trading date strictly after publication calendar date
date_alignment.main_contract: conservative next-exchange-day entry for every record; the main panel does not use a publication-time close cutoff
date_alignment.event_return_3d: compound center-1, center, and center+1 exchange-day returns; this is an event label and may include a pre-publication day
date_alignment.o2o: entry_date open to the next exchange-date open, retained only when both eligible opens are observed
date_alignment.valuation: backward as-of join using the latest available_at less than or equal to published_at
date_alignment.intraday_metrics: future levels and changes are constructed with explicit ticker-wise shifts before stock/date joins

body_mean_baseline.method: PCA32 + Ridge (alpha=100), four Prompt rows averaged within model and dataset
body_mean_baseline.interpretation: This is the first baseline table: body is the article/body segment pooled after the same Prompt-conditioned forward pass; Qwen uses its pre-prompt article_mean because it is causal. Values are descriptive gross Top20 long-short bp without transaction costs. A true no-prompt body counterfactual is not included.

fair_token_body_comparison.method: PCA32 + Ridge (alpha=100), matched body/token folds; four Prompt rows averaged within dataset and model
fair_token_body_comparison.interpretation: Prompt token RankIC and body RankIC are already computed in the same fair experiment. The token is not uniformly stronger: on Sina its average RankIC is below body for all three models, while on CNINFO the matched Qwen and BGE-M3 token averages are above body.

fair_three_model_four_prompt_token_tree.interpretation: Qwen is strongest on both sources. BGE-M3 has the highest cross-prompt factor correlation. Fixed validation-selected trees do not stably beat best-single or equal-weight baselines; no-cost daily bp are comparison statistics, not deployable performance.

prompt_factor.hypothesis: 在相同正文、mask、模型、PCA32、滚动折和标签下，不同目标 Prompt 会产生相关但不相同的可预测因子，而差异不是输入长度或位置伪影。
acceptance: paired 6+2+1 RankIC delta positive in at least 6/9 test years
date-block bootstrap interval for the delta excludes zero
Top20 holdings and daily bp retain an incremental signal after standard factor residualization

model_correlation.interpretation: RoBERTa/BGE-M3 are bidirectional encoders with a pre-text Prompt; Qwen is causal and places the Prompt after the article. Correlation is therefore a standardized predictive/geometry statistic, not a direct understanding score.
next_measurements: Top20 overlap and late-fusion incremental RankIC
model_correlation.complementarity_rule: Only call models complementary when frozen out-of-sample fusion beats the best single model in at least 6/9 years and the paired block-bootstrap interval excludes zero.

regime_expansion.full_universe: Score every eligible stock-day, retain explicit no-news and missingness indicators, and compare coverage, effective holdings, turnover and industry/size exposures.
regime_expansion.hierarchical_design: Index/news aggregate predicts market targets; stock news residualized against the index factor predicts stock excess targets; interact both with volatility/liquidity regimes.
